title: Silver's Project Info | PI
description: Ever wanted the contents and selected version of all of my projects?
body:
# Description
Silver's Project Info is a simple datapack that adds one root advancement allowing all of my projects to display there version, details and much more in it.

the datapack adds nothing else and will only be updated for newer versions or quality of life features.

this datapack is not necessary to be used, but is just here as an optional feature of my datapacks.

# Supported Projects:
- [Way too many Maces!](https://modrinth.com/datapack/silvers_way-too-many-maces)
